item.cosmicbreach.starfall_shard.tooltip: Use it on a frame of a Breach Ring.
item.cosmicbreach.starfall_codex.tooltip: A guide that fell with the stars. In Aetheria, use it while sneaking to find a guardian.
Use it again while the mote flies to switch to the nearest puzzle room, and back.
cosmicbreach.codex.given: A book of starlight settles into your pack: the Starfall Codex.
cosmicbreach.breach.opened: The ground opens onto the sky.
cosmicbreach.breach.no_aetheria: The sky is closed in this world.
cosmicbreach.breach.hint.not_overworld: The sky only opens under the Overworld's stars.
cosmicbreach.breach.hint.centre: Clear the ring's middle: all four blocks of it.
cosmicbreach.breach.hint.headroom: The ring needs two blocks of open air above each of its four middle blocks.
cosmicbreach.breach.hint.missing_many: Missing %s of the ring's 12 frames. The Codex shows the ring.
cosmicbreach.breach.hint.high: A frame sits a block too high: %s.
cosmicbreach.breach.hint.low: A frame sits a block too low: %s.
subtitles.cosmicbreach.onboarding.starfa: A star streaks across the sky
commands.cosmicbreach.starfall.now: A star is falling for you.
commands.cosmicbreach.starfall.nowhere: Found nowhere for a star to land near you.
commands.cosmicbreach.starfall.status: Next Starfall at day time %s (in %s ticks); first fallen: %s; Codex given: %s, opened: %s; ring: %s
commands.cosmicbreach.starfall.reset: Your way in is forgotten: a new first sunset awaits.
